title: The DISTINCT Suspect
subtitle: Find unique card types in the metro system — no repeats!
conceptSummary: SELECT DISTINCT removes duplicate values and shows only unique ones in your result.

dialogue.text: The Metro Authority found that someone is duplicating QR code payments. We need to see all UNIQUE card types used.
SELECT DISTINCT. It removes all duplicate rows from your results. Simple but powerful.

teachMoment.title: DISTINCT: No Duplicates
teachMoment.body:
Without DISTINCT:
SELECT card_type FROM trips
→ metro_card, token, QR, metro_card, metro_card...

With DISTINCT:
SELECT DISTINCT card_type FROM trips
→ metro_card, token, QR (just 3 unique values)

task.instruction: Find all DISTINCT card types used in the metro system. Also find all distinct from_station_id values.

hints.text: Add DISTINCT right after SELECT: SELECT DISTINCT card_type FROM trips
DISTINCT goes between SELECT and the column name.

winDialogue.text: 3 card types: metro_card, token, QR. But one passenger used all 3 types in a single day — that's suspicious!
Someone's testing all payment channels. Could be a system audit... or someone planning a large-scale fraud.

storyBeat: Passenger 1001 used all 3 payment types in one day. Cross-referencing with the pizza orders: Passenger 1001's route goes through the station nearest to Pizza Palace. Coincidence? We think not.
